description: Lets an approved logged-in user publish and edit blog articles from a popup on the live front end, without going into wp-admin.
changelog:
1.36.0

  • NEW: on sites with their own Anthropic key, a new article now starts with one box: write, dictate or paste an idea, a rough draft or a finished article, choose which it is (Article idea, Draft article improve, Finished article only format) and click Generate. The editor then opens with the title, summary, tags and article filled in. After a draft or finished article, a button swaps between your own text and the AI version, both ways. It shows how many generations are left today, warns before a very long text instead of silently cutting it, and gives long articles more room in the reply. "Write it myself instead" skips the box.
  • FIXED: the "Delete this article" button no longer shows on a brand-new article.
  • Sites without a key are unchanged. Includes the Elementor converter from 1.35.0, which stays off unless ticked in Settings.

1.35.0

  • NEW: an Elementor converter for administrators, off unless ticked in Settings > Article Publisher. Tools > Convert Elementor posts converts old posts built in an Elementor HTML widget into normal posts the popup can edit, one at a time, in place, so the address, title, categories, tags, featured image and SEO details stay exactly as they are. It shows a preview first, saves a backup before changing anything, and every conversion can be undone. A rules box turns each site's old class names into real headings and quotes. Nothing changes on a site that leaves the tick-box off.

1.34.0

  • NEW: two WordPress filters, twd_ai_is_configured and twd_ai_complete, so another plugin (TWD Site Kit) can use this site's saved Anthropic key without ever seeing it. Server-side only, nothing changes in the popup, and article generation itself is unchanged. Nothing to do on a site except update.

1.33.0

  • NEW: articles can now be generated directly on a client's own site, without visiting Therapy Resource Directory at all. Add an Anthropic API key under Settings > Article Publisher and the "Draft with Article Assist" link is replaced by an inline generator in the same popup: write from an idea or paste existing text, same as Article Assist itself, landing in the same editable fields either way. No key means no change at all, the popup works exactly as it always has. Runs on the site's own key and its own bill, with a 30-per-day backstop against runaway use (not a real limit), a fixed model for predictable results, and the same review-before-publish behaviour as every other way content reaches this popup.

1.32.0

  • NEW: the Summary Book is now publicly viewable. A published Summary Book gets its own standalone page (?twd_ap_summary_book=1 on the article's permalink) and an in-page overlay, the same two-path pattern the swipe book already uses, sharing the same header/logo/branding and Save as image, Download as PDF and Share features. A "View Summary Book" button appears on the article once one's published, next to the existing swipe book button. Each book now links to the other: the swipe book's footer carries a "View Summary Book" link when one exists, and the Summary Book's own footer carries a "Back to swipe book" link -- clicking either closes the current book and opens the other, reusing the same mechanism the swipe book's "More Articles" slide already used for jumping between articles. Quote and question cards render in their own styles (centred italic serif, gold for a quote with its attribution line, warmer amber for a question), styled after Therapy Resource Directory's own book reader. Article Assist still doesn't produce the draft field yet -- that remains follow-up work in the therapy-resource-directory repo.

1.31.0

  • NEW: the foundation for a curated "Summary Book", entirely separate from the swipe book, which stays a live view and reverts its button/labels to "swipe book" wording. "Summary Book" is now reserved for a new, opt-in, reviewed-before-publish deck of typed cards (text/quote/question), meant to be baked into Article Assist's JSON as a draft and never auto-published from AI output. This version ships storage and a review/edit screen only (a "Summary Book" button on published articles, editable cards, Save Draft/Publish) -- no public-facing display yet, and Article Assist doesn't produce the draft field yet either.

1.30.0

  • FIX: the Summary Book header's background showed a visible seam against the card below it, and stayed fixed while cards swiped past underneath rather than moving with them. Moved the header to be part of each card's own single element, so there's one continuous background with no seam, and logo/border/titles now slide together with the rest of the card.

1.29.0

  • FIX: a slide with a long section of text could overflow the card's fixed height with no way to scroll up to the part pushed out of view above -- a flexbox-centering quirk, fixed with "safe centering" which falls back to top-aligned (always scrollable) once content overflows. Lowered the automatic slide-length threshold (420 to 320 characters) so this is rarer, and long headings now balance their line breaks.
  • NEW: the site heading, "Summary Book" label and logo now sit inside the card's own border as its top section (logo left, heading/label stacked right) instead of floating above it, staying fixed in place as a reader swipes between slides. Save as image / Download as PDF already compose this header into their exports, so this carries over automatically.

1.28.0

  • NEW: renamed "swipe book" to "Summary Book" everywhere it's user-facing (button text, popup labels, help text) -- underlying file/class names unchanged.
  • NEW: every Summary Book now ends with a compact "More Articles" slide, the 6 most recent other published articles by default, no thumbnails, with a hover animation. Clicking one closes the current book and opens that article's own Summary Book in its place. Each article's editor popup gets a picker to choose up to 6 specific articles instead of the automatic latest-6.

1.27.0

  • NEW: the swipe book's header now shows the site's own name (or a custom heading override) above the "Summary Book" label, with a bigger logo below that, both linking out to the site in a new tab. New "Customise this grid" fields: a heading override, the "Summary Book" label text, a logo upload for swipe books only, a logo background choice (Light/Dark/None), and a toggle for including that heading/logo in Save as image / Download as PDF exports (on by default).

1.26.0

  • NEW: the "View as a swipe book" button is softer now: a faint tinted background fill matching its border colour instead of plain white, no underline, and a gentle lift on hover instead of a harsh drop shadow. Its colour is a new picker in "Customise this grid", defaulting to the same sage green used before.
  • FIX: this button also had the [hidden]-style CSS-specificity problem documented elsewhere in this plugin -- a theme/Elementor global link style was beating its !important rules on some sites, showing it as a bare underlined blue link. The selector now carries extra specificity to guard against that.

1.25.0

  • NEW: removed the "Featured" pill badge and its blue border ring from the resources grid entirely (featured articles still sort first, just without calling attention to it). A card's category label no longer shows "Featured Articles" (the landing view's own organisational category, not a topic) when the post also carries a real topic category. The "Card border / featured pill colour" picker is renamed "Accent colour (search focus, category links)" to match what it still controls.

1.24.0

  • NEW: clicking "Update" (or "Schedule") on an article that was already published/scheduled before that click now saves and closes the popup straight away, instead of staying open with a "you can keep editing" message. A brand new Publish, or any Save as Draft, still keeps the popup open.
  • FIX: the swipe book's "Download as PDF" only ever captured whichever single slide was on screen when clicked. It now steps through every slide and builds one multi-page PDF from all of them.

1.23.0

  • NEW: the "Customise this grid" popup now has a "Card border / featured pill colour" colour picker, alongside the existing "Read more" link colour picker. Controls the featured article's card border and FEATURED badge, the search box and category dropdown's focus border, and each category section's "n more" link colour, defaulting to the same blue used before.

1.22.0

  • NEW: the swipe book is now titled "Summary Book" at the top, with a larger site logo underneath it. The page-progress bar moved from the top of the frame to sit small and compact directly under the page number counter. Each slide's card now fills the frame like a quote card, with clamp()-based text sizing so headings and body text scale smoothly with screen size. Added a gold "Download as PDF" button and a "Save as image" button alongside Share, both capturing the currently active card exactly as it renders on screen.

1.21.1

  • FOUND IT: "Load more" was never a logic bug. The DEBUG line showed loadmore_hidden=true on a site where the button was plainly still visible, meaning a theme or page builder's own global button styling (Elementor especially) was overriding the browser's built-in [hidden] default with its own !important display, the same bug class already known here for .twd-ap-articles-grid[hidden]. Added the same explicit [hidden] override to the Load more button, the empty-state message, and the admin popup's small text-link buttons.

1.21.0

  • NEW APPROACH: whether a site has more than 12 published articles is now decided in PHP and baked directly into the resources grid's own server-rendered HTML, instead of being fetched afterward over REST. The grouped-vs-flat decision and whether Load more can ever show no longer depend on any extra request landing or being fresh, since the same page load that renders everything else already carries the answer.

1.20.5

  • TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTIC: a small red DEBUG line now shows under Load more on the resources grid, printing the exact numbers that decided whether it's shown. 1.20.4 should already make Load more impossible to show with 12 or fewer articles; if it's still showing on a site after that update, this line says why directly. Remove once confirmed and fixed.

1.20.4

  • FIX: "Load more" could still show on a site with 12 or fewer articles. The 1.20.0 fix depended entirely on total_articles being accurate to make its per-request fetch naturally come back with nothing left; that dependency was the actual gap. "12 or fewer" is now also a hard, independent condition on showing Load more at all.
  • "View as a swipe book" moved back to the bottom of the article, since a brief stay at the top sat oddly next to a theme's own "Back to Resources" link, which this plugin has no reach into at all.

1.20.3

  • TEMPORARY DEPLOY-CHECK MARKER: the search box, category dropdown and Load more button borders are bright magenta on purpose, not a design choice, to prove whether an update is actually reaching a site that still shows old behaviour after clearing every cache. Revert once confirmed.

1.20.2

  • FIX: the resources grid's REST responses never sent explicit no-cache headers, so a browser or host cache could serve a stale response even after the plugin was updated, most visibly "Load more" still showing when nothing was left to load. Every dynamic endpoint now sends nocache_headers(), and the grid's fetch() calls pass cache: 'no-store', so this self-heals even for a browser with something already cached.
  • FIX: the search box, category dropdown and Load more button are now pill-shaped, matching every other button in this plugin.

1.20.1

  • FIX: the "View as a swipe book" pill moved to the top of the article in 1.20.0, but landed outside the article's own centred content column, prepended after that wrapper had already been built rather than inside it, showing up full-width against the page's actual left edge instead of sitting neatly in the article column. Reordered so it lands inside that column like the rest of the article.

1.20.0

  • NEW: the resources grid only splits into category sections once a site has more than 12 published articles; 12 or fewer show as one plain list. "Load more" only ever appears once there is genuinely another page to fetch.
  • FIX: "Delete this article" in the popup lost its own styling on some sites for the same reason the swipe book's buttons did in 1.19.3, missing !important guards against a theme's own global button styling.
  • FIX: "View as a swipe book" now sits above the article as a proper pill button, instead of below it where it was easy to miss and read as visually adrift.

1.19.3

  • FIX: the swipe book's Close/prev/next/Share buttons could look like bare default Elementor buttons instead of this book's own design, on a site whose theme or page builder sets its own global button styling. The overlay mode injects its markup straight into the live theme page, so it inherits that page's CSS; every visual rule in the swipe book's stylesheet now carries the same defensive weight already used elsewhere in this plugin, so its own styling always wins regardless of the theme.

1.19.2

  • FIX: a published article's text sat flush against the left edge of the page on a theme whose Single Post template gives the content area no width limit of its own. The plugin's article typography set a max-width but never centered it, which most themes never surfaced since their own template already centers the content column. The article now centers itself regardless of what the theme's template does around it.

1.19.1

  • FIX: "Load more" could still show with nothing left to load when a filtered/searched list's total landed exactly on a page boundary. The resources grid endpoint now fetches one extra article beyond what it shows, purely to answer whether there's another page from what actually came back, instead of trusting WP_Query's own page count, which isn't reliable with this grid's featured-articles-first query.

1.19.0

  • "Load more" on the resources grid no longer shows once there's genuinely nothing left to load. Loading articles now shows skeleton placeholder cards, sized the same as real ones, instead of a plain loading line, so the page no longer visibly resizes once the real cards land.
  • The popup's Close button is now pinned to the modal's own top-right corner, outside the row of header buttons, so it never moves. Delete this article is restyled as a smaller, quieter icon+label link there too.

1.18.2

  • IMPORTANT FIX: an article whose only category used to be Uncategorized could vanish from the grouped resources grid entirely after ticking an additional real category and saving, even though the new category looked ticked in the popup. The primary category (which section the article appears under) only got replaced automatically when it was completely unset, so it stayed Uncategorized, and the grouped view drops that whole bucket outright. If this already happened to an article, opening it and clicking Update fixes it, since this runs on every save.

1.18.1

  • Article titles and excerpts with an apostrophe, or a trimmed excerpt's "...", could still show as literal "’" or "…" text on the resources grid, swipe book and elsewhere, despite an earlier fix for this same bug. That fix used wp_specialchars_decode(), which never actually touched those two entities. Switched to html_entity_decode(), which decodes every named and numeric HTML entity back into a real character.

1.18.0

  • A "Delete this article" button now sits at the top of the popup while editing an existing article, moving it to the Trash (not a permanent delete, recoverable from wp-admin).
  • The swipe book's page transitions are rebuilt to match Therapy Resource Directory's own book reader: a page slides fully off and the next slides fully on, no more cross-fade, on the same timing and easing whether tapping the arrows or swiping on touch or with a mouse. The old drag had an inline transform fighting the slide's own CSS transition, which was the actual cause of the jerky feel.

1.17.1

  • Renamed "Import JSON" to "Paste JSON". Fill fields from JSON is now the highlighted button on that tab, and everything else (title, excerpt, details, SEO, Save Draft/Publish) stays out of the way until you click it, so there is nothing to publish by mistake before a draft has been filled in.

1.17.0

  • The swipe book now opens as an overlay right over the resources/article page you were already on (dimmed and blurred behind it), in a fixed-size book card centred on screen, instead of navigating away to a full-page view. A shared link still opens the full standalone page, for when there is no page behind it to show. Slide transitions are smoother, with matched fade and move timing. New: a swipe book can end on a bio slide about you -- set it up once under "Customise this grid" > Profile page (photo, name, a short bio, an optional link button), then tick "Include bio page at end" on any article to close its swipe book with it.

1.16.3

  • Comments and pingbacks are now always off on an article saved through this popup, regardless of the site's own default comment setting. Re-saving an existing article through the popup closes comments on it too; use the Posts list's own Bulk Actions to close comments on many existing articles at once.

1.16.2

  • The "Getting Started" article created on first activation now leads with Article Assist and a direct link into it, instead of listing it third after Visual and HTML. Only affects sites activating the plugin from here on.

1.16.1

  • Fixed a stray "Loading articles..." line showing under the grouped resources grid after it had actually finished loading.
  • The swipe book can now be dragged with the mouse on desktop, not just swiped on a touchscreen, and its card has a layered page-stack shadow instead of a flat drop shadow.

1.16.0

  • The category dropdown now sits before the search box. The separate "Show all categories" button is gone, replaced by a "Show all" option at the bottom of the dropdown. "Uncategorized" no longer counts as a real category anywhere (dropdown, admin order list, or the grouped landing view). The "Customise this grid" popup now has a "Read more" link colour picker, defaulting to a darker blue, darkening slightly on hover.

1.15.0

  • The "New Article" button setting on Settings > Article Publisher is now three choices: everywhere (unchanged default), only on pages with the [twd_articles] shortcode, or not shown at all. An already-configured site keeps its previous behaviour automatically.

1.14.0

  • A "Getting Started With Your New Articles Plugin" article now publishes automatically the first time the plugin activates, so the resources page has real content on day one and new users get a walkthrough of the New Article button, the Visual, HTML and Import JSON tabs, the primary-category star, the resources page and its settings gear, and the swipe book. Edit it into your own message or delete it once ready. Created once only.

1.13.3

  • Renamed to "Articles & Resource Production Plugin" (from "TWD Article Publisher") so it sorts near the top of the alphabetical Plugins list in wp-admin. Nothing else changed.

1.13.2

  • "Could not reach the update server" now shows the actual reason underneath (a timeout, a blocked request, an HTTP error code from GitHub), so a site whose host is blocking the check can be diagnosed instead of guessed at.

1.13.1

  • The swipe book page is restyled to a dark, gold-accented look (serif headings, thin gold hairlines, a gold progress bar and pager) closer to Therapy Resource Directory's own book reader, in place of the earlier bright green/blue gradient. Styling only, no behaviour changed.

1.13.0

  • The [twd_articles] grid now defaults to a grouped-by-category landing view: top categories by article count, each its own titled section, no article repeated across sections. A category dropdown jumps to one category's full list. A gear icon (for anyone who can publish articles) opens a "Customise this grid" popup: category count, articles per category, drag-and-drop category order, and a Show thumbnails toggle. A new star next to each ticked category in the popup sets which one an article is grouped under.

1.12.0

  • Every published article can now be viewed and shared as a swipe book: a full-screen, swipeable slide version split automatically by heading and length, no AI call needed. It is a live view generated on request, always matching the article, not a separate saved copy. A "View as a swipe book" link appears under every article, with a "Swipe book link" also shown in the popup while editing a published article.

1.11.1

  • Fixed scrolling inside the popup bleeding through to scroll the page behind it once you reached the top or bottom of the popup's own content.

1.11.0

  • The popup is renamed "Resource Maker" and restyled with a softer, calmer colour palette (sage green, warm cream, dusty blue) in place of the old bright blue.
  • Shows the site's own logo (Customize > Site Identity) next to the heading, if one is set.
  • "Instructions for use" is now a small circular icon in the header instead of a text link at the bottom.
  • "Draft with Article Assist" is now a proper button, always visible in the header.

1.10.2

  • The Import JSON tab now has a "Draft with Article Assist" link that opens Therapy Resource Directory's Article Assist tool in a new tab, ready to write. Needs a Therapy Resource Directory account. A plain new-tab link, not an embedded popup, since that tool needs the visitor logged into that separate site.

1.10.1

  • A "Check for updates" link now sits on the plugin row on the main Plugins list, next to Deactivate, so you do not need to visit Settings just to trigger an immediate check.

1.10.0

  • New "Import JSON" tab alongside Visual and HTML: paste a JSON block (title, seo_title, meta_description, category, tags, html), for example from TRD's Article Assist tool, and it fills in the title, excerpt, Yoast fields, category and tags and body in one go, then switches to Visual so you can review and edit before saving. Nothing is locked or required, imported fields stay exactly as editable as typed ones.

1.9.1

  • IMPORTANT FIX: the [twd_articles] grid was silently excluding almost every article that had never been marked Feature this article, on every site, since 1.8.0. A bare meta_key query variable turned out to INNER JOIN postmeta rather than LEFT JOIN it, filtering out every post without that meta row. Fixed with an explicit OR meta_query so every post matches, featured or not.

1.9.0

  • Em and en dashes are now automatically stripped from every text field (title, excerpt, tags, article body, category names, Yoast fields) before saving, converted to a comma or dropped where they would double up on other punctuation. Covers the real character and pasted HTML-entity forms, so it applies whether the text was typed, pasted from an AI assistant, or generated by any AI tool.

1.8.2

  • Fixed: titles and excerpts with an apostrophe, or the automatic ellipsis on a trimmed excerpt, could show as literal "’" or "…" text in the resources grid instead of rendering as punctuation.

1.8.1

  • Added a "Check for updates" button on Settings > Article Publisher for an immediate check instead of waiting for the automatic 12-hour cycle.

1.8.0

  • New resources grid: search box, category pills and Load more pagination, all instant with no page reload.
  • A "Feature this article" checkbox pins articles to the top of the grid, ahead of newest-first.
  • Drop the bare [twd_articles] shortcode onto a category or tag archive page and it automatically shows only that term's articles -- no per-page slug needed.

1.7.0

  • Self-hosted auto-updates: every site now checks this repo for new versions and can update in one click from the normal wp-admin Plugins page.

1.6.0

  • Added an "Instructions for use" help screen: toolbar tips, the [twd_articles] shortcode, and a ready-to-copy AI prompt for drafting compatible HTML articles.

1.5.0

  • Added an "Edit in WordPress" link while editing an article. Deliberately no "Edit with Elementor" link.

1.4.0

  • Click any inline image to align it left/center/right/full-width, and drag its corner to resize it.
  • Smaller, correctly-proportioned (3:2) featured image preview with a size hint.
  • Darker, more visible borders on all input fields.

1.3.0

  • Reordered the popup: title, then content, then details (image/categories/tags).
  • Add a new category inline without leaving the popup.
  • Tag autocomplete against existing tags.
  • Embed YouTube videos (click-to-play, privacy-friendly).

1.2.0

  • Published articles now get readable typography for every visitor, not just logged-in editors -- works on any theme, even with no custom Single Post template.

1.1.0

  • Hardened popup CSS against theme overrides.
  • Added a tags field.
  • Added the [twd_articles] shortcode for a card grid of published articles.

1.0.0

  • First release: New Article / Edit This Article popup, categories, featured image, excerpt, Yoast fields, draft/publish/schedule.
